finding_key: packages/documentation/guide/collaboration.md::collaboration doc scopes the comments side panel to documents only, but sheets also has one
evidence: The new section in packages/documentation/guide/collaboration.md is headed "### The comments panel (documents)" and describes opening it only "In a document…", implying the panel is docs-only. The supplied sheets code contradicts that scoping: packages/sheets/src/view/shortcuts-catalog.ts (Comments category) lists `Mod+Alt+Shift+M` → "Toggle comments side panel" in a file whose header calls it the "single source of truth for the keyboard shortcuts shipped by the sheets editor", and packages/frontend/src/app/spreadsheet/sheet-view.tsx has a keydown handler for Cmd/Ctrl+Alt+Shift+M that fires `onToggleCommentsPanel`, plus a `commentJumpTarget` prop for jumping from a thread list to a cell. The reviewer's detail that sheet-view.tsx renders `CommentSidePanel` is inaccurate — sheet-view.tsx only renders `CommentPopover` and delegates the toggle to a parent-supplied callback — and I could not see the parent that hosts the panel, so I cannot fully confirm the sheets panel UI ships. The core claim (a docs-coverage gap: sheets also has a comments side panel/shortcut the doc doesn't mention) is nonetheless supported by the code shown; impact is limited to documentation completeness.
